headline: WATCH: How traffic dried up in the Strait of Hormuz since the Iran war began
summary: The effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz is described as very bad for global oil markets. Iran achieved this with cheap drones rather than a naval blockade.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries about a fifth of global oil consumption, so disruptions there directly move crude prices. Tanker traffic data show how much supply is affected.
why_moved: Traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has effectively stopped since the Iran war began. Iran achieved this with cheap drones rather than a naval blockade, cutting a major oil route.
